prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 6 out of 13 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 6 tests.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, sign-in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns show no positive effect, frequently causing negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives show no clear effect across multiple tests.
Categories with only 1 test (such as adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, and sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning redesigns and too high for changes that produced no clear effect or negative outcomes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Photo Style Alignment Flow: Introduces a step-by-step photo framing and lighting preview checklist on the photo upload screen before custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering failures or unexpected visual output.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Tray Docking Wait Display: Adds a visual guide to the waiting screen illustrating how the pet docks in the system tray while generation completes. (why: Home wait_info features are highly effective ( winning 6 of 13 tests ), addressing user confusion regarding desktop pet controls.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Boundary Setup Info: Displays animated visual info showing screen edge detection and desktop positioning during waiting stage. (why: Home wait_info tests consistently improve retention, and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Render Status Display: Adds a real-time seal rendering status indicator on the adoption certificate screen while processing adoption details. (why: Adoption stage has a high median completion time (89s); providing progress feedback reduces drop-off.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet System Tray Callout Hint: Adds an interactive highlight tip on the home intro screen directing users to the system tray control icon. (why: Addresses user support reports regarding difficulty finding controls or hiding the pet after onboarding.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Multi-Device Account Sync Alert: Adds a clear notification box on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their existing pets will automatically restore. (why: Largest support category (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Sound FX Preview Wait Display: Plays sample audio sound effects and displays sound control hints while waiting for pet generation. (why: Home wait_info features have a proven track record (6 wins), keeping users engaged during the long waiting period (median 201s).)
